core.headline: Ex-local-authority mid-terrace, Lordswood, guide price £285,000
core.listing:
An ex-local-authority mid-terrace house with three bedrooms in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham. Guide price £285,000 freehold. No onward chain.

The lounge measures 4.62m x 3.48m (15'2" x 11'5"). The kitchen/diner measures 5.45m x 2.90m (17'11" x 9'6"). There is a lean-to utility. Gas central heating with a Worcester boiler installed in 2019.

Bedroom 1 measures 3.80m x 3.10m (12'6" x 10'2"). Bedroom 2 measures 3.30m x 2.95m (10'10" x 9'8"). Bedroom 3 measures 2.40m x 2.05m (7'10" x 6'9"). There is one bathroom.

The rear garden is approx. 9m (30ft) with a gate to the shared rear path. Parking is on-street, no permit required.

Lordswood is in Chatham, Kent.

Guide Price £285,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. Construction: Standard – Brick under a concrete tiled roof. Electricity, water (metered) and sewerage are mains. Gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. There is a pedestrian right of way along the shared rear path. Damp mark on bathroom ceiling from a cracked roof tile, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated. Seller unaware of planning or building regulations approval for the lean-to utility.
